title: Flower Power 2-6-4 Organic Bloom Fertilizer | Mario's Super Soil
meta: Flower Power 2-6-4 organic bloom fertilizer for strong roots, lush growth and abundant flowers, indoors and out. Sizes: 2 to 20 lb.
desc: Flower Power 2-6-4 is a premium organic fertilizer that promotes strong roots, lush growth, and vibrant blooms in indoor and outdoor flowering plants.
Its nutrient-rich formula supports abundant flower production, with easy application and clear instructions for gardeners of all experience levels.
Made from alfalfa meal, bone meal, soft rock phosphate, KMS, glacial rock dust, kelp meal, oyster shell flour, gypsum and azomite.
how_en: Use 1 tbsp per gallon of soil or coco. For mature plants, use 2 tbsp per gallon. Use 1/2 tbsp for seedlings.
how_fr: Utiliser 1 c. à soupe par gallon de terre ou de coco. Pour les plantes matures, utiliser 2 c. à soupe par gallon. Utiliser 1/2 c. à soupe pour les semis.
when: 1 tbsp per gallon. Mature plants: 2 tbsp. Seedlings: 1/2 tbsp.
size_note: Our largest bag is 5 lb. 10 lb and 20 lb orders are packed as 2 or 4 of our 5 lb bags, at the same price per pound as the 5 lb bag.

title: Crab Meal 4-3-0 Organic Fertilizer | Mario's Super Soil
meta: Organic crab meal (4-3-0) made from crab and lobster shells. Chitin-rich, high in calcium, with slow-release nitrogen for veggies. Sizes: 2 to 20 lb.
desc: Crab meal is an organic fertilizer made from crab & lobster shells, providing nutrients that support healthy soil & flower and vegetable growth.
The NPK ratio of crab meal is 4-3-0, with a high concentration of nitrogen, phosphorus, and magnesium, and it is particularly rich in chitin.
how_en: Apply in spring and every 2–3 months. Use 1–2 teaspoons per gallon of soil. Yellow leaves may indicate nitrogen deficiency.
how_fr: Appliquer au printemps et tous les 2 à 3 mois. Utiliser 1 à 2 cuillères à café par gallon de terre. Les feuilles jaunes peuvent indiquer une carence en azote.
when: 1–2 tsp per gallon of soil, in spring and every 2–3 months.
size_note: Our largest bag is 5 lb. 10 lb and 20 lb orders are packed as 2 or 4 of our 5 lb bags, at the same price per pound as the 5 lb bag.
use: Root and pest protection, plus calcium

title: Bone Meal 4-10-0 Organic Fertilizer | Mario's Super Soil
meta: Organic bone meal fertilizer (4-10-0) with high organic phosphorus for strong roots, bigger blooms and fruit. Sizes: 2 to 20 lb. Made in Mississauga, Ontario.
desc: Bone meal is an organic fertilizer made from ground animal bones, rich in phosphorus to support strong roots & healthy plant growth.
It also provides calcium, iron, magnesium, and zinc, helping promote healthy stems, leaves, flowers, seeds and fruit production.
how_en: Apply 1–2 tablespoons per gallon of soil. Mix in and water lightly. Nutrients release over 4 months.
how_fr: Appliquez 1 à 2 cuillères à soupe par gallon de terreau. Mélangez et arrosez légèrement. Les nutriments se libèrent pendant 4 mois.
when: 1–2 tbsp per gallon of soil. Releases over 4 months.
size_note: Our largest bag is 5 lb. 10 lb and 20 lb orders are packed as 2 or 4 of our 5 lb bags, at the same price per pound as the 5 lb bag.

title: Kelp Meal 1-0-4 Organic Potassium | Mario's Super Soil
meta: Organic kelp meal (1-0-4) with 70+ ocean minerals. Feeds soil microbes and stimulates strong roots. For soil, coco and teas. Sizes: 2 to 20 lb.
desc: Kelp is a marine algae sourced from nutrient-rich oceans. Often combined with fish products, it promotes healthier plant growth, improves yields, & enhances garden quality.
With an NPK ratio of 1-0-4, kelp meal releases nutrients quickly and provides over 70 vitamins and minerals, including essential micronutrients and macronutrients.
how_en: Mix 1–2 tbsp per gallon of soil. Apply monthly during the growing season.
how_fr: Mélangez 1 à 2 c. à soupe par gallon de terre. Appliquez chaque mois pendant la saison de croissance.
when: 1–2 tbsp per gallon of soil, monthly in the growing season.
size_note: Our largest bag is 5 lb. 10 lb and 20 lb orders are packed as 2 or 4 of our 5 lb bags, at the same price per pound as the 5 lb bag.

title: Alfalfa Meal 3-0.5-3 Organic Fertilizer | Mario's Super Soil
meta: Organic alfalfa meal (3-0.5-3) with triacontanol growth hormone. Conditions and loosens soil, feeds earthworms and microbes. Ideal for soil, beds and teas.
desc: Enhance your garden with Alfalfa Meal, an organic fertilizer and soil conditioner rich in nutrients that promote healthy plant growth.
Made from fermented alfalfa seeds, it has a light texture and pleasant earthy aroma. Apply generously around flowering perennials and shrubs.
ben: Rich in Ca, Mg & trace minerals
how_en: Mix 2 tbsp per gallon of soil. Apply around plants and hedges, mix into soil, and water. Apply in spring; repeat every 6 weeks for long-blooming plants.
how_fr: Mélanger 2 c. à soupe par gallon de terre. Appliquer autour des plantes et des haies, incorporer au sol et arroser. Appliquer au printemps, puis répéter toutes les 6 semaines pour les plantes à longue floraison.
when: 2 tbsp per gallon of soil, in spring and every 6 weeks.
size_note: Our largest bag is 5 lb. 10 lb and 20 lb orders are packed as 2 or 4 of our 5 lb bags, at the same price per pound as the 5 lb bag.
use: Gentle nitrogen and a growth boost

title: Feather Meal 11-0-0 Organic Nitrogen | Mario's Super Soil
meta: Organic feather meal (11-0-0) for lush leaf and stem growth. 2–4 month slow-release nitrogen, ideal for heavy feeders in soil or coco. Sizes: 2 to 20 lb.
desc: Feather meal is an organic fertilizer made from poultry feathers, processed under high heat and pressure, then finely ground into a nutrient-rich powder.
With an NPK ratio of 11-0-0, it provides essential nitrogen for plant development, particularly during the vegetative stage, through both immediate and slow-release nutrition.
how_en: Apply 1–2 tablespoons per gallon of soil or coco. Mix in and water thoroughly. Avoid overapplication.
how_fr: Appliquez 1 à 2 cuillères à soupe par gallon de terre ou de coco. Mélangez et arrosez abondamment. Évitez le surdosage.
when: 1–2 tbsp per gallon of soil or coco. Releases over 2–4 months.
size_note: Our largest bag is 5 lb. 10 lb and 20 lb orders are packed as 2 or 4 of our 5 lb bags, at the same price per pound as the 5 lb bag.

title: Soft Rock Phosphate Organic Fertilizer | Mario's Super Soil
meta: Soft rock phosphate (0-3-0) with slow-release phosphorus, calcium and trace minerals for roots, blooms and fruit. Sizes: 2 to 20 lb.
desc: Soft rock phosphate is a natural mineral fertilizer derived from fossilized marine organisms formed millions of years ago.
It provides slow-release phosphorus, silicon, boron, and trace minerals, improving soil fertility and retaining calcium around plant roots for healthier growth.
how_en: Apply 1 cup per plant at planting or early in the season. For gardens, use 10 lbs per 100 square feet monthly. For containers, mix 2 tbsp per gallon of soil.
how_fr: Appliquer 1 tasse par plante à la plantation ou en début de saison. Pour les jardins, utiliser 10 lb par 100 pieds carrés chaque mois. Pour les contenants, mélanger 2 c. à soupe par gallon de terreau.
when: 1 cup per plant at planting. Containers: 2 tbsp per gallon.
size_note: Our largest bag is 5 lb. 10 lb and 20 lb orders are packed as 2 or 4 of our 5 lb bags, at the same price per pound as the 5 lb bag.

title: Gypsum Calcium & Sulfur Soil Amendment | Mario's Super Soil
meta: Gypsum with calcium and sulfur to loosen heavy clay, improve drainage and prevent blossom end rot without changing pH. 2 to 20 lb.
desc: Gypsum is a natural mineral rich in calcium and sulfur, helping improve water absorption, reduce soil erosion, and support plant growth.
It has little effect on soil pH but helps roots grow by reducing aluminum toxicity, especially in acidic soils, promoting healthier development.
how_en: Use 1–2 tbsp per gallon of soil or coco. For foliar spray, mix 1/2–1 tsp per gallon of water and spray leaves evenly. For soil drench, mix 1–2 tbsp per gallon of water.
how_fr: Utiliser 1–2 c. à soupe par gallon de terreau ou de fibre de coco. Pour les pulvérisations foliaires, mélanger 1/2–1 c. à thé par gallon d’eau et vaporiser les feuilles uniformément. Pour l’arrosage du sol, mélanger 1–2 c. à soupe par gallon d’eau.
when: 1–2 tbsp per gallon of soil or coco.
size_note: Our largest bag is 5 lb. 10 lb and 20 lb orders are packed as 2 or 4 of our 5 lb bags, at the same price per pound as the 5 lb bag.
use: Loosens clay, adds calcium and sulfur

title: Oyster Shell Flour Calcium Amendment | Mario's Super Soil
meta: Ultra-fine oyster shell flour, 96% calcium carbonate, a slow-release calcium source and long-term pH buffer. Sizes: 2 to 20 lb.
desc: Oyster shell flour contains 96% calcium carbonate and micronutrients, providing slow-release nutrition while helping maintain balanced soil pH levels.
Its gradual breakdown provides lasting calcium, reducing the risk of nutrient lockout and supporting consistent nutrient availability for healthier plant growth.
how_en: New pots: 1–2 tbsp per gallon of soil. Established plants: 1 tbsp per gallon. Base mixes: 1 cup per 30 L. Garden beds: 2.5–5 lbs per 100 square feet, mixed into the top 3 inches of soil.
how_fr: Nouveaux pots : 1–2 c. à soupe par gallon de terreau. Plantes établies : 1 c. à soupe par gallon. Mélanges de base : 1 tasse par 30 L. Plates-bandes : 2,5–5 lb par 100 pieds carrés, à mélanger dans les 3 premiers pouces de sol.
when: 1–2 tbsp per gallon of soil. Beds: 2.5 to 5 lb per 100 sq ft.
size_note: Our largest bag is 5 lb. 10 lb and 20 lb orders are packed as 2 or 4 of our 5 lb bags, at the same price per pound as the 5 lb bag.
use: Slow calcium and a steady pH

title: Dolomite Lime Soil Amendment | Mario's Super Soil
meta: Dolomite lime with calcium and magnesium to balance soil pH and reduce acidity. Sizes: 2 to 20 lb. Made in Mississauga, Ontario.
desc: Dolomite lime is a natural mineral amendment containing calcium and magnesium, essential nutrients that support healthy soil and plant growth.
Rich in calcium and magnesium carbonates, it helps balance soil pH, reduce acidity, and improve nutrient availability for healthier plants and gardens.
how_en: Use 1–2 tbsp per gallon of soil. To raise soil pH from 5.5 to 6.5, use approximately 5 lbs per 100 square feet.
how_fr: Utiliser 1–2 c. à soupe par gallon de terreau. Pour augmenter le pH de 5,5 à 6,5, utiliser environ 5 lb par 100 pieds carrés.
when: 1–2 tbsp per gallon of soil. 5 lb per 100 sq ft to raise pH 5.5 to 6.5.
size_note: Our largest bag is 5 lb. 10 lb and 20 lb orders are packed as 2 or 4 of our 5 lb bags, at the same price per pound as the 5 lb bag.
use: Raises pH, adds calcium and magnesium

title: Basalt Rock Dust Volcanic Remineralizer | Mario's Super Soil
meta: Basalt rock dust, a silica-rich volcanic remineralizer for soil mixes and compost with 50+ trace minerals. Sizes: 2 to 20 lb. Made in Ontario.
desc: Basalt rock dust is a natural soil amendment made from finely ground volcanic rock, commonly found around the world.
It breaks down easily in soil, releasing essential minerals that help replenish nutrients, improve soil health, and support stronger plant growth.
how_en: Use 1 tbsp (15 ml) per gallon (4 L) for potting, transplanting, or monthly feeding. For living soil, use 1/4 - 3/8 cup (4–6 tbsp) per gallon.
how_fr: Utiliser 1 c. à soupe (15 ml) par gallon (4 L) pour le rempotage, la transplantation ou l’application mensuelle. Pour un terreau vivant, utiliser 1/4 - 3/8 tasse (4–6 c. à soupe) par gallon.
when: 1 tbsp per gallon for potting. Living soil: 4 to 6 tbsp per gallon.
size_note: Our largest bag is 5 lb. 10 lb and 20 lb orders are packed as 2 or 4 of our 5 lb bags, at the same price per pound as the 5 lb bag.
use: Trace minerals and silica for strong stems

title: Worm Castings Organic Soil Amendment | Mario's Super Soil
meta: Organic worm castings packed with live microbes. Improves water retention, never burns, activates dry amendments. For soil, coco and teas. Sizes: 1 L to 4 gallons.
desc: Worm castings are a natural fertilizer produced by earthworms, also known as vermicast. These castings consist of earthworm waste.
As worms consume compost materials, their nutrient-rich waste creates a superior soil amendment that supports healthier plant growth.
how_en: Mix into potting soil or sprinkle around plants. For established plants, use 1–2 cups. Water thoroughly.
how_fr: Mélangez au terreau ou saupoudrez autour des plantes. Pour les plantes établies, utilisez 1 à 2 tasses. Arrosez abondamment.
when: Mix into potting soil, or 1–2 cups for established plants.
size_note: Worm castings and compost are sold in litres and gallons, not by weight, because the weight changes with moisture. Roughly: 1 L is about 1 to 1.3 lb, 1 gallon about 4 to 5 lb, 2 gallons about 8 to 10 lb and 4 gallons about 15 to 20 lb.

title: Compost Blend Organic Soil Builder | Mario's Super Soil
meta: Premium compost blend (0.7-0.3-0.6) that enriches organic matter, improves water retention and builds healthy humus. Sold by the litre and gallon.
desc: Compost is a carefully balanced mixture of organic materials utilized as a plant fertilizer, improving the physical, chemical, and biological properties of soil.
It is typically produced by decomposing plant matter, food waste recycling of organic materials, and various types of manure.
micro: Varie selon la litière et l’alimentation
how_en: Mix 1 part compost with 4 parts soil, or spread on garden beds and lawns. For compost tea, aerate in water for 24–48 hours.
how_fr: Mélangez 1 part de compost avec 4 parts de terre, ou épandez sur les plates-bandes et les pelouses. Pour le thé de compost, aérez dans l’eau pendant 24 à 48 heures.
when: 1 part compost to 4 parts soil, or spread on beds and lawns.
size_note: Worm castings and compost are sold in litres and gallons, not by weight, because the weight changes with moisture. Roughly: 1 L is about 1 to 1.3 lb, 1 gallon about 4 to 5 lb, 2 gallons about 8 to 10 lb and 4 gallons about 15 to 20 lb.
